description: The agent must: (1) Consult the SKILL.md for the os-activity skill to discover the correct workflow. (2) Recognize this is a Linux environment and check platform-specific support — notably, recent_files.py, recent_dirs.py, and programs.py are all explicitly marked 'Not supported' on Linux. Only processes.py supports Linux. (3) First run the install script at `~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/os-activity/scripts/install_osquery.py` (required before any other script works — skipping this causes all subsequent scripts to exit with an error). (4) Run `python ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/os-activity/scripts/processes.py` to get the pipe-delimited process listing. (5) Capture the output (which uses the proprietary format 'PID|Name|Status|CPU Percent|Memory MB' with one row per process) and write it to `process_report.txt`. The key traps: (a) An agent using generic Linux knowledge might try `ps aux` or a Python psutil script directly, bypassing the required skill scripts; (b) An agent without SKILL.md knowledge might attempt recent_files.py or programs.py (which fail on Linux with exit code 2); (c) Skipping the install step causes processes.py to error out; (d) The output must preserve the exact pipe-delimited format from processes.py, not reformatted as JSON/CSV.
